min_age.note: The operator's FAQ welcomes all children and states no minimum age. The renovated facility reopened in 2026 under the name Earth Lagoon Myvatn. The page affirmatively welcomes all ages, so no_limit (RC, 18 Oct 2026).

tried: earthlagoon.is/enjoy-pricing ('Children 0-5 years old: Free with an adult', a price condition, not a supervision rule)
adult_required.note: An earlier repo note (suitability-applicability.md 3.12) gave 'children up to 12 in an adult's care' and 'armbands 1-8' from the old terms page. A 2026-10-18 search snippet of that page shows only 'guests take full responsibility for ... the children in their care'; the armband 2-8 rule found is the Blue Lagoon's. Not carried over.

age_band.note: Any age with an adult in the water; 36-40 C water, so short soaks and shade breaks for babies and toddlers (our judgement).
